description: This file defines a React functional component called 'Board' that renders a 3x3 tic-tac-toe game board. It accepts properties for the game state, including the current board, game over status, click handler, and next player. The component maps over the board array to render individual 'Cell' components, and includes styling for layout.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: React functional component that renders the tic-tac-toe board based on passed props.
